RC-5 suppresses \( \mathcal{T}_{tm} \) when no front injuries exist. RC-6 introduces \( \mathcal{D}_{stale} \), reducing \( \mathcal{S}_{stat} \) validity. Each defect is a singularity in \( \mathcal{C} \) and \( \mathcal{T} \) generation, causing cascading failures in \( \mathcal{S} \) and \( \mathcal{I} \) integration.
